title: Better HUD
description: Modern and colorful hotbar and sprite update.
body:
A **simple texturepack** that modernizes Minecraft's ancient HUD to be **bright, colorful, and clean, while maintaining a lot of its charm and character.**

---

## Features
 
- **Clean attack indicator** - Much brighter and stands out, matching the crosshair
- **Updated heart sprites** - Updates all of the heart textures to be more colorful and clear
  - Blinking heart is now pink!
- **Updated hunger sprites** - More clean and colorful hunger shanks
- **Improved armor bar** - Replaces iron armor with shiny shield icons
- **Updated ride health** - Replacing the confusing saddle heart texture, a shiny new horseshoe is used to display your ride's health
- **Modern hotbar** - Updates the grainy and inconsistant hotbar texture to be modern and nice
- **Colorful selection** - The hotbar selector is now a stand out blue, built right into the hotbar
- **Better bars** - The boss bars and XP bar have a more colorful, standout texture

![Fighting a creeper with the texture pack enabled](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4ddb20019dfee221221ee26908dad2a3b0a2a651_0.webp)
